title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The pinned live head, runner, plan, candidate delta, assets, native imports, cache and tool guards passed. Under one exclusive lock, Windows PowerShell 5.1 parsed the prepared runner successfully with exit zero and no parser errors; the parser process exited before lock release. The candidate build was deliberately not launched: its parallel MSBuild plan can create descendants, while the launcher accounts only for the direct process. A separate source-only launcher correction must provide auditable descendant completion before another build assignment. The pristine baseline remains passed, but candidate compilation and review convergence remain unfinished.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
